title: Molly and the Little Loader
synopsis: From the farm side Molly watches a compact loader bring gravel while the crew finishes the rails and both approaches.
continuity_state: Before: Wooden deck installed but no rails, finished approach paths or opening. After: Rails and both gravel approaches are installed and examined. The bridge is still behind temporary barriers until the crew opens it. Molly keeps her blue rope toy at the farm porch.
